name: Matching Mugs
text: When you buy this sigil, choose another sigil you own for it to become a copy of.
timing: Always on, for you (the copy is chosen at purchase)

signature.effect: permanent copy of a chosen common sigil you own

archetypes: Bonus Chaser, Diamond Flood, Heart Chorus; any collection with a key common
decision: Shopping: which common to double for the rest of the run, and when to buy it (after the key common lands).
opponent: The copy acts like any sigil and is shown when it triggers.
aiNote: Buy only when you own a common worth 12 or more a round, and copy the one with the highest expected value; never a shop or selling common unless the collection is economy-led.
rationale: A second copy of your best sigil for the rest of the run, from +12 for a common to a second multiplier for a rare; the copy is engraved each round like any sigil, keeps the original's affinity, stays if the original is sold, and a copied counter starts its own count; the one-time choice keeps it below Forger's Brush (GY-R03), which chooses each round.
deviation: Redesigned in revision 1: the per-round copy on this card matched Spare Key (TE-U01), which copies a partner's sigil each round, so this duplicates at the collection level with a single choice at purchase.
